note: Small Missouri River access at the end of D Avenue south of Langdon. The primitive camping area is at the parking lot at the end of a short gravel lane, in a clearing in the bottomland woods above the river, with a privy nearby. --Claude

Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual; privy added. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.

Imagery: the lane ends in a small mowed clearing (~40 x 30 m) under the canopy edge. A small lot, but a drive-in gravel lane to it; a 23-ft rig should fit with care. Stays.
